summary: The Verge's Sheena Vasani rounds up competing sales from retailers like Best Buy, Walmart and Target that run alongside Amazon's fall Prime Big Deal Day, so non-Prime members can also get steep discounts. Some retailers match Amazon's prices on items such as the Kindle Paperwhite and Echo Pop. Deals are grouped by category, including headphones, tablets, e-readers, smart displays, gaming, TVs, smartwatches, doorbells and security cameras.
one_line: The Verge rounds up Best Buy, Walmart and Target tech deals competing with Amazon's October Prime Big Deal Day, available without a Prime membership.
key_facts: Sony's WH-1000XM4 over-ear headphones are $250 (down from $350, 29% off) at Best Buy and last up to 30 hours per charge.
Sony's WF-1000XM5 earbuds are $280 (down from $300, 7% off) at Best Buy, with richer sound, slightly more powerful ANC and a smaller, lighter design.
The 2021 iPad (64GB, Wi-Fi) is $249 (down from $329, 24% off) at Amazon and Walmart; it has a 10.2-inch screen, an A13 Bionic chip and is the only iPad with a 3.5mm headphone jack.
The 10th-gen iPad (64GB, Wi-Fi) is $399.99 ($50 off) at Best Buy and Walmart, with a 10.9-inch screen and USB-C.
The Echo Show 5 (third-gen) is $50 (down from $90, 44% off) at Best Buy.
The Google Nest Hub (second-gen) is $60 (down from $100, 40% off) at Walmart and tracks sleep with its Soli radar chip.
The Sony InZone H9 gaming headset is $245 at Amazon and $250 at Best Buy (down from $300) and works with PCs and the PlayStation 5.
The Seagate Storage Expansion Card (1TB) for Xbox Series X / S is $130 (down from $220, 41% off) at Best Buy.
The 2022 Samsung The Frame TV (55-inch) is $1000 (down from $1500, 33% off) at Best Buy.
The Roku Streambar is $100 (down from $130, 23% off) at Amazon, Best Buy and Target.
The Samsung Galaxy Watch 4 starts at $149.99 ($50 off) at Best Buy in the Bluetooth 40mm configuration.
The Blink Video Doorbell is half off at $29.99 at Best Buy, and the Blink Mini camera is $19.99 ($15 off).
The Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Pro is $200 (down from $250, 20% off) at Amazon and Best Buy, with 2,000 lumens of light.
